name: Web 3 Dollar
oneLiner: USD3 is a Reserve Protocol RToken/DTF backed by yield-bearing USDC and USDS wrappers (Aave, Compound, Steakhouse, Sky savings), governed by RSR stakers.
collateral: Reserve Protocol DTF basket made up of Savings USDS, Aave USDC, wrapped Compound USDCv3, and Steakhouse USDC strategy exposure
pegMechanism: Reserve RToken/DTF whose holders can redeem into the backing basket subject to Reserve protocol throttles and basket mechanics; RSR stakers govern and absorb losses

reserveReview.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 backing review
reserveReview.rationale: The live Reserve DTF transparency API identifies USD3 by address and reports four collateral tokens with weights of approximately 25% each. Reserve documents describe Yield DTFs as baskets minted and redeemed against their collateral, with basket configuration governed onchain. The prior rounded weights are replaced with the API snapshot values.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Reserve DTF transparency API snapshot cross-checked against Reserve Yield DTF documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The current collateral token identities and weights are disclosed, but the API does not disclose the underlying custody allocation or protocol-level reserve composition inside the wrapped strategy tokens.

mintAuthority.summary: USD3 is a Reserve Protocol Yield RToken/DTF: anyone can permissionlessly mint by depositing the governed collateral basket and redeem for it, while RSR stakers govern via Governor Anastasius → 3-day TimelockController (OWNER_ROLE on Main). A 3/5 guardian Safe can cancel timelock proposals.

controls.label: USD3 RToken mint/redeem (BasketHandler)
controls.capDescription: Permissionless mint requires depositing the full governed collateral basket in proportion; mint/redeem are throttled by protocol issuance/redemption rate limits.

Main.rToken() returned 0x0d86883FAf4FfD7aEb116390af37746F45b6f378 (confirmed USD3). Main.basketHandler() returned 0x19835E5817A6fDC944100E86da2FCe86327457B8. frozen()=false, issuancePaused()=false.

controls.label: Governor Anastasius → TimelockController (OWNER_ROLE on Main)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295271: RoleGranted logs on Main proxy (0x81117e3e) show OWNER_ROLE (0x4f574e45..) held by TimelockController 0x848b923b5d99d5963608ff55acdfee51c443cca6 (3-day minDelay). TimelockController RoleGranted logs show PROPOSER+EXECUTOR role held by Governor Anastasius 0xd895a5d391fc09f12e8c8d57cfde5c59bfbe2fa7; Governor.token() returned 0x55230B05d4c1F4a0B4f804dc52919F06355DfBF8 (stRSR for USD3), confirming RSR staker governance. CANCELLER role on Timelock held by guardian Safe 0xd5fe2780eb882d1da78f2136b81c2a4395488c98 (3/5 Safe, no modules, no guard, masterCopy 0xd9db270 = Safe 1.3.0).

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295271: USD3 RToken.main()=0x81117e3e (MainP1 proxy). Main OWNER_ROLE held by TimelockController 0x848b923b (getMinDelay=259200s=3 days). Timelock PROPOSER/EXECUTOR=Governor Anastasius 0xd895a5d3; Governor.token()=stRSR 0x55230B05 (RSR stakers). CANCELLER=3/5 Guardian Safe 0xd5fe2780 (5 owners, threshold 3, no modules, no guard). Issuance not paused, not frozen. Base deployment not separately verified but shares Reserve Protocol governance pattern.
